# Green Pheonix Concept

> Performance marketing agency from Brașov, Romania. We build marketing systems that bring real clients — Meta Ads, Google Ads, organic social media, websites that convert.

## About
Green Pheonix Concept is an independent agency founded by Laurențiu Bogdan, specialized in performance marketing for serious businesses. Our entry prices are public, on the [Pricing](https://greenpheonixconcept.com/en/preturi/) page; we set the final package individually, in your quote — we recommend only what works for your specific context. We operate in Romania, Italy and across European markets.

## Services
- [Meta Ads](https://greenpheonixconcept.com/en/servicii/meta-ads/): Facebook and Instagram campaigns for lead generation and sales
- [Google Ads](https://greenpheonixconcept.com/en/servicii/google-ads/): Search, Performance Max, YouTube campaigns
- [Social Media](https://greenpheonixconcept.com/en/servicii/social-media/): Strategic organic content for authentic growth
- [Web Development](https://greenpheonixconcept.com/en/servicii/web-development/): Websites that convert, optimized for results
- [Strategy & Audit](https://greenpheonixconcept.com/en/servicii/strategie-audit/): Diagnosis before execution
- [Content Production](https://greenpheonixconcept.com/en/servicii/content-production/): Content that sells, not just content

## Entry prices
Indicative "from" prices; the exact package is set individually, in your quote. Details: [Pricing](https://greenpheonixconcept.com/en/preturi/)
- Social Media Management: from €250/month
- Social Media + Ads: from €500/month (ad spend is paid separately, directly to Meta)
- Custom (video shoots and production, Google or TikTok Ads, funnels, more platforms): on request
- Business website: from €500 (one-time payment)
- Complex / custom website: on request
- Prices are final — Green Pheonix Concept is not VAT-registered.

## Philosophy
1. **Simplicity that sells** — decorative complexity distracts
2. **Organic foundation** — ads alone don't work without a real organic presence
3. **Authenticity** — a conversion and an algorithm factor
4. **Strategy before execution** — diagnose, then act

## Case studies
- [Kokoro Ju Jitsu Academy](https://greenpheonixconcept.com/en/portofoliu/academia-kokoro-rebrand/): Full rebrand and +595% organic Instagram growth in 3 months, with zero Meta Ads
- [Lemet Stone](https://greenpheonixconcept.com/en/portofoliu/lemet-stone-plugin-marketing/): Custom SBC Calculator plugin + Meta Ads: 855 site visits from 750 RON, May 2026

## How we work
1. **Discovery call** (30 min, free) — we listen before we recommend
2. **Full audit** (€150, delivered in 48h) — we analyze what works and what doesn't; fully deducted from your first invoice if we work together
3. **Strategy** (5-7 days) — a clear recommended path
4. **Implementation** (variable) — technical and creative setup on milestones
5. **Optimization & reporting** (monthly) — we iterate on what works
